ruling: Lance 2026-08-06: start_date means the start of the CURRENT term/stint being served; the openstates/people open-role start_date is authoritative for it. LegiScan earliest-qualifying-year answers a different question (first service in the chamber), so year-mismatch where LegiScan-first-seen precedes the OpenStates current-role start is the expected benign pattern for returning members. Surname-format mismatches were individually identity-verified (same seat, name spacing/hyphen/compound differences).
